label: Śrī Nāma-Māhātmya
title: kṛṣṇa-nāma dhare koto bal
metaDescription: Śrī Nāma-Māhātmya of Śaraṇāgati (‘Surrender’) written by Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in 1893. This songbook contains 50 songs detailing the six symptoms of surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.translation: What power does the name of Kṛṣṇa possess? My heart constantly burns in the fire of worldly desires, just like a desert scorched by the rays of the sun. The holy name, entering the core of my heart through the holes of my ears, showers unparalleled nectar upon my soul.

translit: hṛdoya hoite bole, jihvāra agrete cale,
kanṭhe mora bhaṅge swara, aṅga kāṅpe thara thara,
verses.translation: The holy name speaks from within my heart, moves onto the tip of my tongue, and constantly dances on it in the form of transcendental sound. My throat becomes choked up, my body shivers again and again, and my feet cannot remain still.
deva: हृदोय होइते बोले, जिह्वार अग्रेते चले,
कन्ठे मोर भङ्गे स्वर, अङ्ग काङ्पे थर थर,
bengali: হৃদোয হোইতে বোলে, জিহ্বার অগ্রেতে চলে,
কন্ঠে মোর ভঙ্গে স্বর, অঙ্গ কাঙ্পে থর থর,

translit: cakṣe dhārā, dehe gharma, pulakita saba carma,
verses.translation: Rivers of tears flow from my eyes, perspiration completely soaks my body, all my skin thrills with rapture, my hairs stand on end, and my complexion turns pale and discolored. My mind grows faint, I begin to experience devastation, and my entire body is shattered in a flood of ecstatic emotions.
deva: चक्षे धारा, देहे घर्म, पुलकित सब चर्म,
bengali: চক্ষে ধারা, দেহে ঘর্ম, পুলকিত সব চর্ম,

translit: kori’ eto upadrava, citte varṣe sudhā-drava,
kichu nā bujhite dilo, more to’ bātula koilo,
verses.translation: While causing such an ecstatic disturbance, the holy name showers liquid nectar on my heart and drowns me in the ocean of divine love of Godhead. He does not allow me to understand anything, for He has made me truly mad by having stolen away my mind and all my resources.
deva: कोरि’ एतो उपद्रव, चित्ते वर्षे सुधा-द्रव,
किछु ना बुझिते दिलो, मोरे तो’ बातुल कोइलो,
bengali: কোরি’ এতো উপদ্রব, চিত্তে বর্ষে সুধা-দ্রব,
কিছু না বুঝিতে দিলো, মোরে তো’ বাতুল কোইলো,

translit: loinu āśroya jā’r, heno vyavahāra tā’r,
kṛṣṇa-nāma icchā-moy, jāhe jāhe sukhī hoy,
verses.translation: Such is the behavior of Him in whom I have taken shelter. I am not capable of describing all this. The holy name of Kṛṣṇa is independent and thus acts on His own sweet will. In whatever way He becomes happy, that is also my way of happiness.
deva: लोइनु आश्रोय जा’र्, हेनो व्यवहार ता’र्,
कृष्ण-नाम इच्छा-मोय्, जाहे जाहे सुखी होय्,
bengali: লোইনু আশ্রোয জা’র্, হেনো ব্যবহার তা’র্,
কৃষ্ণ-নাম ইচ্ছা-মোয্, জাহে জাহে সুখী হোয্,

translit: premera kalikā nām, adbhuta rasera dhām,
verses.translation: The holy name is the bud of the flower of divine love, and is the very abode of astonishing mellows. Such is the power He manifests that when His holy name starts to blossom a little further, it then reveals His own divine form and qualities. Thus my heart is abducted and taken directly to Kṛṣṇa.
deva: प्रेमेर कलिका नाम्, अद्भुत रसेर धाम्,
bengali: প্রেমের কলিকা নাম্, অদ্ভুত রসের ধাম্,

translit: pūrna vikaśita hoiyā, braje more jāya loiyā,
more siddha-deha diyā, kṛṣṇa-pāśe rākhe giyā,
verses.translation: Blossoming fully, the flower of the holy name takes me to Vraja and reveals to me His own love-dalliance. This name gives to me my own eternal spiritual body, keeps me right by Kṛṣṇa’s side, and completely destroys everything related to this mortal frame of mine.
deva: पूर्न विकशित होइया, ब्रजे मोरे जाय लोइया,
मोरे सिद्ध-देह दिया, कृष्ण-पाशे राखे गिया,
bengali: পূর্ন বিকশিত হোইযা, ব্রজে মোরে জায লোইযা,
মোরে সিদ্ধ-দেহ দিযা, কৃষ্ণ-পাশে রাখে গিযা,

translit: nāmera bālāi jata, saba lo’ye hoi hata,
verses.translation: The name of Kṛṣṇa is a transcendental touchstone, a mine of all devotional mellows. It is eternally liberated, and the embodiment of pure rasa. When all impediments to the pure chanting of the holy name are taken away and destroyed, then my happiness will know its true awakening.
deva: नामेर बालाइ जत, सब लो’ये होइ हत,
bengali: নামের বালাই জত, সব লো’যে হোই হত,
